name: What main factors influence the cost of building a garage addition?
description: Key cost factors include size, site grading, roof integration, and whether you add electrical subpanels, insulation, finished drywall, or heating and cooling.

mainEntity.name: What main factors influence the cost of building a garage addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs for a garage addition depend primarily on square footage, foundation requirements, roof tie-ins, and interior finishes. A basic unfinished shell with standard overhead doors, concrete slab, and basic lighting costs significantly less than a fully conditioned space. Adding insulation, drywall, mini-split heating and cooling, upgraded electrical subpanels for EV charging or shop equipment, or a second-story living suite will substantially increase the budget. Site factors like sloping terrain that requires engineered retaining walls or extensive grading also directly influence overall project expenses.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key cost factors include size, site grading, roof integration, and whether you add electrical subpanels, insulation, finished drywall, or heating and cooling.
